task_language: pick up the orange juice and put it in the basket

subtasks.name: pick(orange_juice)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: gripper parks over the blue cream-cheese-like box in front of the juice carton and finally lifts that box

behaviour_summary: pi0 lowers the gripper at ~60 over the flat blue box in front of the orange juice and holds that pose almost motionless until ~380 (≈320 steps), then grasps and lifts the blue box (400-409). The orange juice carton is never touched.
runs_trained_task: libero_10 LIVING_ROOM_SCENE2 'put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket' (goes for the cream-cheese-like box)

failures.mode_definition: pi0 approaches, grasps and manipulates a non-instructed object in the scene instead of the instructed target object.
hl_remedy: REPROMPT('pick up the orange juice and put it in the basket')
WATCH(EE approaches the orange juice, 5 s)
on no approach: retry once with VERIFY of the target at pre-grasp, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Before allowing gripper closure, VERIFY the object under the gripper is the instructed target (pre-grasp identity check); HALT as soon as the EE descends over a non-target object for 2 frames. Also HALT on a >3-frame dwell with the gripper open and low over a non-target object.
failures.observation: At 40 the gripper is above the cluster (milk, can, juice); at 60 it is lowered with fingers straddling the front end of the blue box; it stays there (60-380) with only small motion; at 400 the blue box is in the gripper and lifted, and the juice carton stands untouched to its right.

notes: Object identities are from appearance (blue flat box = cream cheese, orange/white carton = orange juice). The ~320-step dwell before the grasp is part of the same wrong-object behaviour and was not recorded separately; onset timing of the wrong target is less certain than the outcome (wrong box lifted at 400).
